knowledge-base.name: netcoredbg-dotnet-attach
knowledge-base.triggers: netcoredbg, dotnet debugger, attach debugger, mcp-debugger dotnet, debug aspnet, debug csharp process, DAP tcp
knowledge-base.overview: How to attach netcoredbg to a running .NET process via TCP DAP for use with mcp-debugger. Includes the correct DAP protocol flow, known limitations, and Windows-specific issues.

setup.step: Find target process PID: Get-Process -Name 'MyApp' | Select-Object Id
Start in server+attach mode: netcoredbg.exe --interpreter=vscode --server=4711 --attach PID
IMPORTANT: Must include --attach PID. Server-only mode (no --attach) resets connection immediately.

dap-protocol-flow.critical: netcoredbg sends ALL module/thread events IMMEDIATELY after client connects, BEFORE the client sends initialize.
The client MUST send initialize CONCURRENTLY (in a background recv thread), not sequentially after draining events.

sequence.step: 2. Server immediately streams 100+ module events and thread events
3. Client sends initialize request (do NOT wait for event stream to finish — send immediately)
4. Server sends capabilities event + initialize response + initialized event
5. Client IMMEDIATELY sends configurationDone when initialized event arrives (no delay)
6. Server sends configurationDone response — session is live
7. Client can now send setBreakpoints and wait for stopped events

dap-protocol-flow.pitfall: Any sleep between connect and initialize sends will cause connection reset — the event stream completes and server closes if no initialize arrives in time.
Always use UTF-8 stdout on Windows: sys.stdout = open(sys.stdout.fileno(), mode='w', encoding='utf-8', buffering=1) — DAP messages contain Unicode arrows that crash Windows charmap.

net10-incompatibility.symptom: netcoredbg crashes (and kills the target process) immediately after setBreakpoints is sent
initialize handshake succeeds, initialized event fires, but first post-handshake command crashes the server
net10-incompatibility.root-cause: netcoredbg 3.1.3 cannot inject breakpoints into .NET 10 processes on Windows
net10-incompatibility.check-runtime: Look at module event paths — if they include Microsoft.NETCore.App\10.0.0 the process is on .NET 10
net10-incompatibility.note: DOTNET_ROLL_FORWARD=Disable does NOT help if the project itself targets net10.0 (TargetFramework in csproj)
net10-incompatibility.workaround: Use Visual Studio Attach to Process — vsdbg is fully .NET 10 compatible
Use VS Code with C# Dev Kit extension — also uses vsdbg internally

mcp-debugger-behavior.issue: mcp-debugger create_debug_session with host+port gets ECONNRESET — cannot handle server-first event stream
mcp-debugger attach_to_process with host+port has the same issue
mcp-debugger-behavior.root-cause: mcp-debugger sends initialize synchronously after connecting; netcoredbg closes if no initialize arrives before event stream ends
mcp-debugger-behavior.status: mcp-debugger does not work with netcoredbg for .NET 10 projects — use raw TCP DAP (Python) or VS debugger

python-dap-client.description: Working Python pattern — concurrent recv thread sends initialize immediately on connect
python-dap-client.key-pattern: Start recv in thread. Send initialize with 0.05s delay. In on_msg handler: when initialized event arrives, IMMEDIATELY send configurationDone (no sleep).
python-dap-client.encoding: Force UTF-8: sys.stdout = open(sys.stdout.fileno(), mode='w', encoding='utf-8', buffering=1)
